name: Shaqat Beetle Swarm

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

resistances.name: Melee and Ranged
resistances.details: Half damage from melee and ranged attacks

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.details: The swarm can occupy the same square as another creature, and an enemy can enter its space, which is difficult terrain. The swarm cannot be pulled, pushed, or slid by melee or ranged attacks. It can squeeze through any opening that is large enough for a Tiny creature.

hit.description: The swarm grabs the target (escape DC 20). Until the grab ends, the target takes ongoing 10 damage. The target takes 10 damage when the grab ends.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature grabbed by the swarm

hit.description: damage plus 4d10 poison and psychic damage.

effect.description: At the end of the encounter, the target makes a saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts cerebral parasites (stage 2).
The swarm jumps up to 2 squares. If the swarm ends this jump in the same square as another creature, it gains combat advantage against that creature until the end of the current turn.
